status.description: A contract_warning has priority over taste_nudge; no_finding means neither stage has a packet-grounded result.

evidence_seq.description: The visible tool-result sequence that grounds a finding; 0 only for no_finding.

anchor.description: The smallest exact implementation location that owns or reveals the gap: a code identifier, function, field, or state transition.

relationship.description: One short Traditional Chinese relationship. A contract warning identifies an unmet task requirement and task-breaking behavior. A taste nudge names two concrete implementation elements that visibly carry the same responsibility and states the conflict exposed by that overlap after the contract stage yields no warning; replacement design remains with the Actor. The Host renders the status marker, principle, and anchor separately.
